name: kms_rotation_drill

proves: T3 opens with a persisted local keyring.
Pre-rotation and post-rotation payloads both unseal successfully.
Batch signatures remain verifiable across a retained-key roll.
CrossCheck batch-signature metadata persists in wal/cross_check/batch-signatures.cbor.
Snapshot/restore plus sidecar reload preserves verification state.
The admin plane surfaces custody path, active key id, and rotation cadence.
Emergency rotation emits auditable key-roll metadata.
Audit-chain verification remains intact after rotation.

notes: T3 in this checkout is a local persisted keyring seam, not a remote cloud KMS integration.
Recovery now verifies completed CrossCheck batch signatures before MCP open.
